title: Cargo registry credentials
whyItMatters: Cargo can store crates.io and private registry tokens in this file. Anyone with the token can publish crates as the person.
source: Cargo docs, Registry authentication: tokens are saved in $CARGO_HOME/credentials.toml, which is ~/.cargo by default - https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/registry-authentication.html
notes: Older Cargo versions used a file named credentials with no extension; CARGO_HOME can move the folder. A logged-in token can be revoked from the crates.io account settings.

cleanup.signOut: Revoke the registry tokens in the crates.io account settings, so the tokens copied from this Mac stop working.
steps: Revoke the tokens in the crates.io account settings.
Delete the file named in the plan using Finder.
Run cargo logout in a fresh terminal if Cargo is still installed.
cleanup.risk: Removes the saved registry logins from this Mac. Tokens that are not revoked keep working from any machine.
